grammars.text:
# Glob pattern grammar — the structured form of a shell glob, including
# extended globbing (`shopt -s extglob`). The Glob matcher parses a
# pattern with this grammar and walks the resulting AST into a RegExp.
#
# Only patterns that contain an extglob opener route through here; plain
# `*` / `?` / `[…]` globs keep their original fast string scan. So this
# grammar always parses at least one extglob group, but it also has to
# understand every ordinary glob metachar that can sit alongside one.
#
# The five extglob operators each take a `|`-separated list and may nest:
#   ?(list) *(list) +(list) @(list) !(list)
# Nesting is handled by ordinary grammar recursion (`itemIn` → `extGroup`)
# rather than a Block delimiter — a raw depth-scan would miscount escaped
# parens, whereas the `escaped` rule (tried before any literal) consumes
# `\(` / `\)` / `\|` as literals so they never affect group structure.

# ─── Leaf metacharacters ────────────────────────────────────────────
# `escaped` is first in every item list so `\X` is always a literal.
escaped     = /\\./
doubleStar  = "**"
star        = "*"
question    = "?"

# Character class `[…]` / `[!…]` as one escape-aware regex: a leading `]`
# (or `!]`) is part of the class (`[]]`, `[!]]`), `\]` stays inside, and
# the class ends at the first unescaped `]`.
charClass   = /\[!?\]?(?:\\.|[^\]])*\]/

# `extOpen` is a negative-lookahead sentinel (operator char glued to `(`):
# a literal run stops before it so the operator starts a group instead.
extOpen     = /[?*+@!]\(/
extOp       = /[?*+@!]/
open        = "("
close       = ")"

# ─── Literal runs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A literal char is anything not handled above. Two variants: top-level
# treats `(` `)` `|` as ordinary chars; inside a group `(`/`)` bound
# (nested) groups and `|` divides alternatives, so all three are excluded
# there. Every char is guarded by `!extOpen` so a run never swallows the
# operator char of a following extglob group.
litTopChar  = /[^*?\[\\]/
litInChar   = /[^*?\[\\|()]/
litTopUnit  = !extOpen + litTopChar
litInUnit   = !extOpen + litInChar
litTopRun   = (litTopUnit)+
litInRun    = (litInUnit)+

# ─── Items ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# extGroup is tried first so an `op(` commits to a group before the
# operator char is read as a literal.
itemTop = extGroup | escaped | charClass | doubleStar | star | question | litTopRun
itemIn  = extGroup | escaped | charClass | doubleStar | star | question | litInRun

# ─── Extglob group ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# `extGroup` recurses through `itemIn`, so nested groups Just Work without
# a delimiter scan. An empty alternative (`@(a|)`) is allowed.
extAlt   = (itemIn)*
extAlts  = (extAlt, "|")+
extGroup = extOp + open + extAlts + close

# ─── Top level ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
globPattern = (itemTop)+
